name: MIDEJ
description: A mysterious and powerful warrior, whose origins are as enigmatic as their fighting style. They wield destruction with a calm and calculated demeanor.

name: PHAENON
description: A being of pure energy, Phaenon is a manifestation of a dying star. Their attacks are wild and unpredictable, much like a solar flare.

name: SABER
description: A master swordswoman, Saber's blade is said to be able to cut through dimensions. Her stoic expression hides a passionate and determined heart.

name: YUNLI
description: A graceful and elegant fighter, Yunli commands the power of storms. Her movements are like a dance, beautiful yet deadly.

name: JINGLIU
description: Once a legendary sword master, Jingliu is now a fearsome warrior shrouded in ice. Her attacks are relentless and unforgiving, chilling her enemies to the bone.

name: DAN HENG IMBIBITOR LUNAE
description: The High Elder of the Vidyadhara, Dan Heng wields the power of the celestial waters. His attacks are both beautiful and devastating, capable of washing away his foes.

name: BLADE
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters, Blade is an immortal swordsman who seeks death. His body is a vessel of destruction, and his attacks are fueled by his own life force.

name: CLARA
description: A young girl who travels with a powerful robot named Svarog. Clara provides support while Svarog unleashes devastating attacks to protect her.

name: FIREFLY
description: A mysterious and cheerful girl in a mech suit. Firefly is a member of the Stellaron Hunters, and her true identity and motives are unknown.

name: SEELE
description: A spirited and valiant member of Wildfire who grew up in the Underworld of Belobog. She is accustomed to being alone.

name: YANQING
description: A prodigiously talented swordsman and the lieutenant of the Xianzhou Luofu's Cloud Knights. He is obsessed with swords and is one of the most skilled swordsmen on the Luofu.

name: TOPAZ & NUMBY
description: Topaz is a senior manager of the Strategic Investment Department in the Interastral Peace Corporation. Her partner, Numby, is a Warp Trotter with a keen sense for treasure.

name: DOCTOR RATIO
description: A candid and self-centered Intelligentsia Guild member, who often conceals his appearance with a strange plaster sculpture. He firmly believes that intelligence and creativity are not confined to geniuses.

name: BOOTHILL
description: A cyborg cowboy drifting among the stars. He's an optimistic and unrestrained Ranger who is a member of the Galaxy Rangers.

name: FEIXIAO
description: A skilled pilot and a member of the Galaxy Rangers. Feixiao is known for their sharp wit and even sharper shooting skills.

name: ARCHER
description: An unknown archer whose arrows are said to never miss. They are a silent and deadly force on the battlefield.

name: HIMEKO
description: An adventurous scientist who encountered and repaired a stranded Astral Express as a child, she now journeys across the universe with it.

name: JING YUAN
description: One of the seven Arbiter-Generals of the Xianzhou Alliance's Cloud Knights. He is a master tactician and a formidable warrior.

name: ARGENTI
description: A classic knight of the Knights of Beauty. He is noble, admired, and wanders the cosmos alone, resolutely following the Path of Beauty.

name: YASHMA
description: A beautiful and enigmatic dancer, Yashma's movements are said to be able to captivate and control the minds of her audience.

name: RAPPA
description: A small, furry creature with immense power. Rappa may look cute, but it's a force to be reckoned with in a fight.

name: GREAT HERTA
description: The master of the Herta Space Station. She is a brilliant scientist who has turned her consciousness into a puppet.

name: ANAXA
description: A powerful sorceress who commands the forces of nature. Anaxa can summon storms and earthquakes to vanquish her enemies.

name: BRONYA
description: The heir to the Supreme Guardian of Belobog, and the commander of the Silvermane Guards. She is a capable and righteous leader.

name: RUAN MEI
description: A sweet-tempered and elegant scholar, and Member #81 of the Genius Society. She is an expert in the biological sciences.

name: SPARKLE
description: A member of the Masked Fools. She is a master of drama and an inscrutable character, obsessed with finding amusement.

name: ROBIN
description: A Halovian singer born in Penacony, who has become a galactic superstar. She is known for her beautiful voice and elegant demeanor.

name: SUNDAY
description: A Halovian singer and Robin's older brother. He is a devout follower of the Family and a man of great influence in Penacony.

name: TRIBBI
description: A mischievous and playful creature who loves to cause chaos. Tribbi's attacks are unpredictable and often comical.

name: KERIDRA
description: A wise and ancient being who has witnessed the rise and fall of civilizations. Keridra possesses immense knowledge and power.

name: WELT
description: The wise and seasoned former Anti-Entropy Sovereign who has saved Earth from annihilation time and time again. He is now a member of the Astral Express crew.

name: SILVER WOLF
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters and a genius hacker. She can crack any defense system and sees the universe as a massive immersive simulation game.

name: KAFKA
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters, whose name is on the Interastral Peace Corporation's wanted list. She is a beautiful and deadly woman.

name: BLACK SWAN
description: A Memokeeper of the Garden of Recollection. A mysterious and elegant soothsayer with a warm smile.

name: ACHERON
description: A mysterious Galaxy Ranger who claims to be a wanderer of the cosmos. Her true name is unknown, and she walks the Path of Nihility.

name: JIAOQIU
description: A cunning and manipulative strategist, Jiaoqiu always seems to be one step ahead of their opponents.

name: FUGA
description: A silent and deadly assassin, Fuga moves like a shadow and strikes without warning.

name: CIFER
description: A master of disguise and deception, Cifer can infiltrate any organization and extract any information.

name: GISILENSA
description: A powerful and ancient being, Gisilensa is said to be able to control the flow of time itself.

name: GEPARD
description: The captain of the Silvermane Guards, he is a righteous and meticulous man responsible for the defense of Belobog.

name: FU XUAN
description: The head of the Xianzhou Luofu's Divination Commission. She is a confident and blunt sage.

name: AVENTURINE
description: A senior manager in the IPC's Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. He is a man who loves high-stakes gambling.

name: BAILU
description: A young Vidyadhara healer known as the 'Healer Lady' on the Xianzhou Luofu. She is a kind and compassionate doctor.

name: LUOCHA
description: A handsome and elegant man who carries a giant coffin on his back. He is a skilled merchant and a powerful healer.

name: HUOHUO
description: A timid and pitiful Foxian girl who is also a Ten-Lords Commission Judge-in-training. She is afraid of ghosts, but has to catch them.

name: LINSHA
description: A gentle and caring healer, Linsha is a beacon of hope on the battlefield. Her touch can mend any wound.

name: AGLAIA
description: A being of pure light and memory, Aglaia is a guardian of the past, present, and future.

name: CASTORIA
description: A powerful warrior who can call upon the spirits of fallen heroes to aid her in battle.

name: HYACINA
description: A beautiful and deadly siren, Hyacina's song can lure her enemies to their doom.
